# ReMeet

> Designed PDF book from $29 (30 pages) or $79 (100 pages). Printing after you approve your book: hardcover from $69, premium layflat from $129, US and Canada shipping included. Ships to the US, Canada and Europe. ReMeet is a done-for-you photo book design service. You share an iCloud or Google Photos link, a designer curates your best photos, lays out every page, and delivers a proof within 72 hours. Every book is checked by a person, not auto-generated. Video frame extraction add-on: +$50. Founded by Olga Miller, based in Porto, Portugal, serving customers worldwide.

## Pricing

- Designed PDF book, up to 30 pages: $29
- Designed PDF book, up to 100 pages: $79
- Upgrade from 30 to 100 pages after ordering: +$50
- Video frame extraction add-on: +$50
- Printed hardcover: $69 (up to 30 pages), $119 (up to 100 pages)
- Printed premium layflat: $129 (up to 30 pages), $199 (up to 100 pages)
- Extra printed copies: $69 each
- Shipping: included to the US and Canada, +$15 to Europe
- Your next book: 10% off the design
- Christmas: order printing by Dec 1, a PDF by Dec 20
- Don't love the first draft? Full refund

## How it works

1. Pick your book type and page count
2. Pay and share a link to your photos (iCloud or Google Photos)
3. Receive a designed proof in 72 hours
4. Request changes in plain language (two revision rounds included)
5. Approve and download, or order a printed copy (from $69, US and Canada shipping included)

## What makes ReMeet different

- A designer checks every book by hand
- AI sorts and selects photos, but never changes or generates them
- 5 minutes of your time vs. hours of DIY layout work
- Accepts up to 5,000 photos per book
